Hello{{name}}! 👋 I'm **CAFA AI Assistant**.

What would you like to know?

settings.title: AI Assistant Settings
settings.subtitle: Configure and monitor the CAFA AI Assistant.
settings.noPermission: You don't have permission to view this page.
settings.uatDesc: The AI_ENABLED environment variable is not set to true on the server, so the AI assistant will not be visible to users regardless of the toggle below. You can still pre-configure these settings — they will take effect once the env var is enabled at deployment time.
settings.assistantStatusDesc: Enable or disable the floating AI widget for all users.
settings.aiEnabledDesc: Users see the 'Ask CAFA AI' button on all pages.
settings.aiDisabledDesc: The widget is hidden from all users.
settings.responseLanguageDesc: Controls what language the AI responds in.
settings.additionalInstructionsDesc: Extra instructions appended to the AI's system prompt. Use this to customise behaviour, add org-specific guidance, or restrict topics.
settings.promptPlaceholder: e.g. Always remind users to save their work. Do not discuss personal staff information. Focus answers on operational project management...
settings.security1: AI access is restricted to authenticated users only.
settings.security2: The AI receives only role-filtered context — it cannot access data outside the user's permissions.
settings.security3: All AI interactions are logged in the Usage Logs tab.
settings.security4: OpenAI API credentials are managed securely via environment variables and never exposed to clients.
